items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was playing piano, with Lawrence Brown, Johnny Hodges, Al Hall the bass player, Denzil Best the drummer, and Billy Strayhorn was playing congas.

ctx.x: And I was lucky to have those men to, you know. Then there was another time when I used to -- oh, we were recording another small label, I was playing piano, with Lawrence Brown, Johnny Hodges, Al Hall the bass player, Denzil Best the drummer, and Billy Strayhorn was playing congas.
What were those records, all of them?
